nodes.n: Arrivals, Heathrow. 6:40 AM. You've been told nothing except "be at Gate C at 6:30 and bring a coat."
Then Shibu walks through the sliding doors in a borrowed blazer, and behind him, in a navy winter coat three sizes too big over her cream saree, is Amma.

nodes.t: The riverbank fund! Chairs, chai, and one very aggressive auction of your old bat! We had enough for two tickets!
It's so cold. How do people live here? Where is the sun? Who took it?
Come here. Let me look at you. You're thin. I knew it. I brought fish pickle.

choice.t: Lift her off the ground in a hug.
Hug Shibu so hard his blazer button pops.

nodes.n: 11 AM. The inquiry's last day. Rekha Iyer asked for you to be there. Bhandari is there too, with a lawyer and a face like a closed shop.

nodes.t: The selection minutes are real. Three selectors have confirmed it. The source has confirmed it. The vetoes were not cricket. They were family.
Mr Bhandari is removed as chairman of selectors, permanently. The Board will also review every selection he made in six years.
Six years I gave this game. And a boy from a boat ends it.

choice.t: "I didn't end it. You did. Nine times."
choice.d: The truth, finally said out loud.

choice.t: "I hope Aryan gets a fair chance now. He's better than you let him be."
Say nothing. Let him walk out.

nodes.n: Bhandari picks up his folder. At the door he stops, like he's about to say something. He doesn't. He walks out, and nobody watches him go.
For one second, Bhandari's face changes. Like you've said something nobody has said to him in years. Then he walks out.
Evening. The team hotel. Amma is in the kitchen. She has made friends with the head chef in forty minutes, through hand signals and fish pickle.
The whole team eats rice and fish curry off hotel plates. Harpreet has three helpings. Sameer asks for the recipe and Amma says no.

nodes.t: Amma, he bats at four tomorrow. In the World Cup final. I hope you're not nervous.
Nervous? I raised him on a boat. He's been nervous since he was born. I'm the calm one.

nodes.n: Late. You find Amma on the balcony, wrapped in two blankets, looking at a sky with no stars.

nodes.t: Your father would have been unbearable this week. He would have told every person in England that his son plays cricket.
Tomorrow, when it's hard, and it will be hard, find out who's rowing with you. Then row.

nodes.cliff: The final. Amma in the stands. Shibu in a borrowed blazer. Diya in the press box. And sixty thousand people who've never heard of Kuttanad.
